relationships.evidence_quote: Loganin also reduced pain-associated channel protein CaV3.2 and calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) in the surficial spinal dorsal horn of PDN rats.

relationships.subject: Loganin
relationships.evidence_quote: Our animal studies corroborated that loganin inhibited the phosphorylation of NF-κB in the spinal cord of PDN rats.

relationships.subject: Loganin
relationships.evidence_quote: Loganin inhibited oxidative stress and NF-κB activation and decreased the levels of mRNA and protein of proinflammatory factors IL-1β and TNF-α.

relationships.subject: Loganin
relationships.evidence_quote: Loganin inhibited JNK activation and regulated the IRS-1-AKT-GSK3β signaling pathway by inhibiting oxidative stress

key_findings: Loganin reduced CaV3.2 and CGRP in the spinal dorsal horn and improved pain behaviors in STZ-NA diabetic rats.
Loganin inhibited oxidative stress, NF-kB activation and TNF-alpha/IL-1beta, and modulated JNK-IRS1-Akt-GSK3beta signaling.
